subject: Otyugh
picture: Create an original refuse-dwelling scavenger with a heavy low body, one large front mouth with simple triangular teeth, three thick animal legs, two long rubbery side tentacles ending in bristly pads rather than hands, and one back stalk carrying three small eyes. Use an independently designed silhouette and details. Refuse sacks and bones establish the habitat. Stone ceiling, walls, closed door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
